question: Can source-plus-target refit's useful signal and the existing mature error observer jointly improve delivery, and does learning the combination during service add value beyond a fixed blend?
models: Use identical source-only scaling, source plus previously returned target balanced logistic fit, and identical mature observer counts as feedback-refit-transfer. Each iteration issues normalized probabilities. Observer starts with smoothed vote counts (one per class plus ballots); after feedback use the current observer's smoothed conditional likelihoods. Preserve its existing hard-label tie rule.
decision: Start at 0.5. Minimize the sum of past returned-label negative log likelihoods for a convex probability mixture using one scalar w in [0,1]; add the fixed penalty -log(w)-log(1-w) to avoid extreme estimates from few returns. Use the true-class probabilities as issued before consuming any feedback of that batch, with equal class weight within cumulative history so target class mix does not erase minority classes. Total mass equals number of labeled observations. For tied final probabilities use the incumbent observer class when tied then smallest class. Fit both models and issue shadow predictions under the same budget for all mixing arms.
frozen_rule: All five feedback-refit streams, same 13 seeds, same service IDs and same returned labels. Compare main averages by stream, changes in worst class recall, source-only mature experts and hard switch. To send learned mixture for independent testing require >=0.01 improvement over all fixed weights including endpoints and over learn-once in >=2 streams, worst recall no more than 0.02 below the best-scoring fixed mixture there; no official public average loss >0.01 vs observer. Retain a strong fixed recipe as a candidate separately when supported. No deployment on replay alone.
scope: All five streams have previously been scored. For a linked single-device stress test carry history over the known public-to-late drift transition; a fresh reset is a privileged boundary control. No post-score tuning.
